patch_description: The prior program already raised `sigma_acc` cap to 0.85·σ_r and added the dynamics-aware blend (second listed variant), but the current champion reverted to cap 0.6 and no blend, scoring the same 0.72 (corr 0.89, reversals 14.2, lag 0.34). Gen 72-style operating points showed corr ~0.96 / lag ~0.30 are reachable with reversals kept low by the polish stage. Reintroduce the raised cap (0.6→0.85·σ_r) and the dynamics-aware blend floor `clip(1.25−1.25·dyn_ratio, 0.10, 1.0)`: strong dynamics shift weight to the responsive refined pass (less lag, higher correlation) while the uniform-λ Whittaker polish (guarded against σ_r from the ORIGINAL input) suppresses the extra ripple, keeping false reversals near 14. This samples the unsampled frontier point between (0.72, 14.2) and (0.67, 30.6) reversals, targeting corr ~0.93 at comparable reversal count.
